title: Foundry backends & strict PHI payload logging exclusion

test_cases.name: Request body hidden from gateway logs
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect APIM diagnostics logging configuration for request body capturing
test_cases.expected_result: Request body is categorically excluded (0 bytes captured in logs)
test_cases.evidence: APIM diagnostics-phi-safe policy configures 0-byte payload logging (request body excluded)

test_cases.name: Response body hidden from gateway logs
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect APIM diagnostics logging configuration for response body capturing
test_cases.expected_result: Response clinical note text is excluded from all diagnostic log sinks
test_cases.evidence: APIM diagnostics policy explicitly excludes response bodies containing clinical notes

test_cases.name: Safe header logging and credential redaction
test_cases.input_setup: Process request headers through gateway log sanitizer
test_cases.expected_result: Operational headers preserved; Authorization and api-key strictly redacted

test_cases.name: Dynamic Foundry backend routing
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect foundry-backend.xml policy for target backend resolution rules
test_cases.expected_result: Routes dynamically to designated Foundry deployment via set-backend-service
test_cases.evidence: APIM foundry-backend policy routes extraction requests dynamically to correct Foundry deployment

test_cases.name: APIM gateway latency overhead bound
test_cases.input_setup: Measure round-trip latency difference between direct backend and gateway proxy
test_cases.expected_result: Gateway introduces < 20 ms p95 latency overhead
test_cases.evidence: Gateway overhead measured at 6.50ms < 20ms p95 threshold
